comment: UZZ-X has no parameters and no outputs; every jack acts on the UZZ immediately to its right through the expander connection, and nothing it does is saved with the patch. Index order is not panel order for the bottom four jacks: index 10 is ROT + on the right and index 11 is ROT - on the left, and index 8 is REV on the right with index 9 RST on the left.
